definitions.summary_identity: (campaign, result_file, case, label); result_file distinguishes screens and confirmations
definitions.sample_identity: (campaign, result_file, case, label, round); sample_index is also preserved
definitions.wall_p50: sample median; even N averages the two middle observations
definitions.p95_p99: nearest rank; sparse upper tails are descriptive, not stable production guarantees
definitions.rss: per-link process peak RSS, not an average resident working set; MiB=KiB/1024
definitions.environment: label-specific overrides only; inherited host environment is not captured
definitions.phase_workers: for original-baseline descendants with default threads on CPUs32-63, observed per-case worker count comes from separate instrumentation; effective phase cap is inferred from S1 wrapper semantics, not counted during timings. TableGen default12 means cap16 is inactive
definitions.output_mode: fresh means only the harness output was unlinked before each link outside link timing; reused means the harness output pathname was retained. Neither mode flushes input caches
definitions.output_hash: harness verifies last measured output per case/label; copied to sample rows as group provenance
definitions.profiled: timed --perf phase runs kept separate by flag; untimed counters and perf-record kernel samples are not link timing rows
definitions.source: explicit frozen binary hash mapping; never inferred from current branch heads. Original f8638be9 topic baseline, prior1347ca95 rebased stage, and latest75200f10 stage have distinct source lineage and anchors
definitions.complete: requested sample count and final binary/output digests are all present
